question: Will London's temperature exceed 23°C on Oct 5, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded maximum air temperature in London, UK, at any point strictly after 2026-10-04T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-05T23:00:00Z exceeds 23°C.
- "No": Wins if the recorded maximum air temperature in London, UK, does not exceed 23°C at any point strictly after 2026-10-04T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-05T23:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- "Temperature" refers to the observed or reanalysis 2 m air temperature (°C) for Greater London; hourly readings within the window are used to determine whether the 23°C threshold was exceeded at any point during that period.
